public import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Written on the Wall II - Conjecture 13

*Reference:*
[E. DeLaVina, Written on the Wall II, Conjectures of Graffiti.pc](http://cms.dt.uh.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/)
-/

@[expose] public section


namespace WrittenOnTheWallII.GraphConjecture13

open SimpleGraph

variable {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] [Nontrivial α]

/--
WOWII [Conjecture 13](http://cms.dt.uh.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/)

For a simple connected graph `G`, the size `b(G)` of a largest induced bipartite subgraph
satisfies `b(G) ≥ diam(G) + max_{v ∈ V} l(v) - 1`, where `diam(G)` is the diameter
of `G` and `l(v) = indepNeighborsCard G v` is the independence number of the
neighbourhood of `v`.
-/
@[category research solved, AMS 5]
theorem conjecture13 (G : SimpleGraph α) (h : G.Connected) :
    letI maxL := (Finset.univ.image (fun v => indepNeighborsCard G v)).max' (by simp)
    (G.diam : ℝ) + (maxL : ℝ) - 1 ≤ b G := by
  sorry

-- Sanity checks

/-- The largest induced bipartite subgraph invariant `b G` is nonneg for any graph. -/
@[category test, AMS 5]
example (G : SimpleGraph (Fin 3)) : 0 ≤ b G := Nat.cast_nonneg _

/-- In `K₂`, all vertices have degree 1, so `indepNeighborsCard` at vertex 0 is 0
(the neighbourhood of 0 consists of only vertex 1, which has no independent edges). -/
@[category test, AMS 5]
example : (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin 2)).maxDegree = 1 := by decide

end WrittenOnTheWallII.GraphConjecture13

findings.description: The docstring of the anonymous K₂ test (lines 56–59) incorrectly says `indepNeighborsCard` at vertex 0 is 0 and refers to "independent edges." This invariant counts independent vertices: the neighborhood is the singleton {1}, so its independence number is 1. Moreover, the attached example proves only `K₂.maxDegree = 1`, not a statement about `indepNeighborsCard`. The theorem and invariant definitions themselves are correct.
findings.source_evidence: DeLaVina's WOWII definitions, entries 4 and 5 in wowIIdefs.js, define local independence as "The independence number of the subgraph induced by the neighbors of vertex v" and independence number as "The maximum number of vertices such that no two are adjacent." Read at https://web.archive.org/web/20260723211215id_/http://cms.uhd.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/wowIIdefs.js. Independently proved `indepNeighborsCard (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin 2)) 0 = 1` in /workspace/review/scratch.lean.
findings.suggested_fix: Change the docstring to describe the existing test, e.g. "The maximum degree of K₂ is 1." Alternatively, correct the local independence value to 1 and add a test of `indepNeighborsCard (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin 2)) 0 = 1`.

reformulations.difference: Lean assumes `[Nontrivial α]`, whereas the source says simply "a simple connected graph." This excludes the one-vertex connected graph.
reformulations.equivalence_argument: The excluded case satisfies the bound automatically: its diameter and every neighborhood independence number are 0, so the left side is −1, while `b G` is nonnegative. Thus the assertion for nontrivial finite connected graphs is equivalent to the assertion for all finite connected graphs. A generic subsingleton-case proof and the corresponding ↔ were checked in /workspace/review/scratch.lean.

sources_consulted: E. DeLaVina, Written on the Wall II, archived cited homepage: https://web.archive.org/web/20240726223145id_/http://cms.dt.uh.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowii/
WOWII all conjectures, Conjecture 13 and its accompanying note: https://web.archive.org/web/20260726061534id_/http://cms.uhd.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/all.html#conj13
WOWII definitions 4, 5, 14, 15 and 21, and bibliographic record for Conjecture 13: https://web.archive.org/web/20260723211215id_/http://cms.uhd.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/wowIIdefs.js
Local Mathlib sources: Combinatorics/SimpleGraph/{Basic,Clique,Maps,Bipartite,Finite,Metric,Diam}.lean; Coloring/Vertex.lean; Connectivity/Connected.lean; Data/Finset/Max.lean.
Local review guidance: STATEMENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, AGENTS.md, and FormalConjectures/WrittenOnTheWallII/README.md.
Supplied calibration material: both INDEX.md files; all eight not_misformalizations examples; past_misformalizations/pr01256.md, pr01870.md, pr02295.md and pr04282.md.
review.notes: The main conjecture faithfully states the source's inequality. Both the all-conjectures and resolved lists mark Conjecture 13 true and credit DeLaVina and Waller (2004), agreeing with `research solved`. Checked both anonymous tests, finite/nonempty maximum and supremum semantics, diameter's disconnected default (excluded by connectedness and finiteness), and real casts/subtraction. Scratch checks independently established the K₁ and K₂ cases and evaluated the computable invariants on empty graphs and small complete/edgeless graphs. The only finding is the test docstring error. The live cited site was unavailable; its archived source pages supplied the statement, definitions and resolution record.
